title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Statement Guide: Statement Dates, Due Dates and the Minimum Payment
content:
**When a statement is issued.** A statement of a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account is issued for every billing period on the account's statement closing day in which the account has a non-zero balance or any transaction. The billing period is named by the year and month of the closing date.

**Payment due date.** The payment due date is the statement date plus the card's grace period in calendar days.

**Disputed amounts.** Amounts under open billing dispute on the closing date are recorded on the statement as the disputed amount excluded and are left out of the minimum payment calculation.

**Minimum payment due.** The minimum payment due is the full statement balance (less the excluded disputed amount) when that is at or below the card's minimum payment floor; otherwise it is the greater of the minimum payment floor and the card's minimum payment principal percent of that balance plus the interest and fees of the period, rounded half up to the cent; in every case the past-due amount (unpaid minimum payments from earlier statements) is added on top. A credit or zero balance has a minimum payment due of 0.00. The interest and fees of the period are the interest charges and fees belonging to the billing period, less the fee reversals belonging to it.

**Special financing.** The statement shows the remaining special financing balance as its promotional balance, and shows the promotion's end date.

## Worked minimums (hypothetical card: floor USD 40.00, principal percent 1)

| Statement balance | Disputed amount excluded | Interest and fees of the period | Past-due amount | Minimum payment due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 30.00 | 0.00 | USD 2.00 | 0.00 | USD 30.00 (balance at or below the floor) |
| USD 2500.00 | 0.00 | USD 30.00 | 0.00 | USD 55.00 (25.00 plus 30.00, above the floor) |
| USD 1200.00 | 0.00 | USD 10.00 | 0.00 | USD 40.00 (22.00 is below the floor) |
| USD 2500.00 | USD 500.00 | USD 30.00 | USD 40.00 | USD 90.00 (20.00 plus 30.00, plus 40.00 past due) |
| a credit of USD 15.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | USD 0.00 |

A statement dated on the 5th of a month on a card with a 25-day grace period has a payment due date on the 30th of that month.
